description: Reads a public storefront and reports every advertising, analytics and marketing tag visible in its HTML, with the actual measurement ids. It then verifies each Google id against Google Tag Manager, because an id Google does not recognise returns 404 and silently stops gtag from initialising, which means a campaign can spend for months while recording zero conversions. Use this to explain why conversion tracking is wrong, or to see what a store you have no access to is running.

url.description: The storefront URL, for example example.com or https://example.com.

verify_google_ids.description: Check each Google id against Google Tag Manager to catch dead ids. Default true.

name: detect_tracking_tags
title: Find the advertising and analytics tags on a storefront
